ctx.x: Because that was the, he, like Chris, Renier, points and all of them, so them was real jazz players. Sonny was a, Celestan was a good trumpet player. I give it to him. I think he'd, he's one of our best. Come down to that dicks and all that, well, Sonny had, he had, he always kept some guys with him. Remember? Sonny, Celestan had a little guy by the name of Guy Keller. He was, y'all ready? Y'all, y'all talk to him, man.
He made some records in Chicago. Yeah, that little. I heard him once up there, too.
